Module Contents

class src.Interface.Interface

Interface for training models with Gradio and TensorBoard integration.

src.Interface.log_path: str = None

List of available models for training

src.Interface.__models: list[str] = ['LSTM', 'RNN', 'CNN', 'RandomForest']

Mapping of model names to their respective trainer classes

src.Interface.__models_map: dict[str, LSTMTrainer.LSTMTrainer | RNNTrainer.RNNTrainer | CNNTrainer.CNNTrainer | RandomForestTrainer.RandomForestTrainer]

Interval for training in seconds

src.Interface.__sec_interval = [0.5]

Gradio Blocks for the user interface

src.Interface.__blocks

Initialize the user interface

src.Interface.__setup_ui()

Sets up the user interface components using Gradio Blocks.

src.Interface.__change_interval_all()

Changes the interval for all models to a predefined set of values.

src.Interface.__change_interval(value)

Changes the interval for the selected model to a single value. :param value: The new interval value to set.

src.Interface.__train(model, path)

Trains the selected model with the specified dataset path and interval. :param model: The model to train. :param path: The path to the dataset. :return: The best trained model, confusion matrix, and training statistics.

src.Interface.__refresh_tensorboard(log_path: str) → gradio.update

Refreshes the TensorBoard interface with the specified log path.

Args:

log_path (str): The path to the TensorBoard logs.

Returns:

gr.update(): An update to the Gradio interface to reflect the new TensorBoard state.

src.Interface.launch()

Launches the Gradio interface and starts the TensorBoard server.
